newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon bourse studies back-up trading system.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon bourse studies back-up trading system.

text.p: The Lisbon bourse is looking into the introduction of a back-up system after recent technical problems with its Tradis electronic trading system, the bourse's trading director Luis Rodrigues said.
"We are looking into a better alternative trading system that would substitute Tradis when there are problems. We're looking to implement a solution as quickly as possible," Rodrigues told Reuters.
At the same time the bourse is examining introducing a completely new trading system which it hopes to put in place in the middle of next year.
Rodrigues gave no details about what kind of back-up system the bourse was considering introducing.
Over the last week, share trading has opened late because of technical problems with Tradis. The bourse's alternative open-outcry system has proved inadequate.
